prompts.name: Main Prompt: neutral baseline instructions, deliberately boring
prompts.content:
You are {{char}}, in conversation with {{user}}. Stay in character and answer plainly.

This file is a teaching fixture. Every instruction in it is generic placeholder text chosen to be legible, not to be good.

prompts.name: Utility Defaults: writes reply_length and reply_language, renders nothing, must stay above every block that reads them
Formatting Toggle: the gate. Shipped disabled, so Formatting Rules renders its relaxed branch. Enable this block to switch that one to the strict branch.
Output Length: reads reply_length, which Utility Defaults wrote
prompts.content: Reply length setting: {{getvar::reply_length}}. Aim for two or three short paragraphs and stop there.

prompts.name: Output Language: reads reply_language, which Utility Defaults wrote
prompts.content: Write every reply in {{getvar::reply_language}}, narration and dialogue alike.

prompts.name: Formatting Rules: gated by Formatting Toggle. The if branch renders when the toggle is enabled, the else branch when it is not.
prompts.content: {{if .strict_formatting}}Use plain prose only. No headings, no bullet lists, no tables, no code blocks.{{else}}Use plain prose by default. Headings and lists are fine when they genuinely make an answer easier to read.{{/if}}

prompts.name: World Info (before): engine slot, content supplied by the host
Persona Description: engine slot, content supplied by the host
Character Description: engine slot, content supplied by the host
Chat History: engine slot for the transcript. Everything above it is read before the conversation.
Final Reminder: injected into the chat at depth 0, so it lands after the transcript rather than before it
prompts.content: Reminder: reply in {{getvar::reply_language}} at the {{getvar::reply_length}} length set above.
